snippet.title: Clay Hunt VR for Meta Quest
snippet.description:
Clay Hunt VR is a realistic shotgun shooting game for Meta Quest VR headset.

Feel the thrill of shotgun shooting, hone your skills in virtual reality and challenge your friends in multiplayer competitions! Clay Hunt VR is a realistic shotgun sports game with clay shooting and bird hunting modes. Hunting season is always open!

Check out the new add-ons: Lakeside sporting course and wild boars with rifle or shotgun!

The game requires only the headset. You can optionally get a gun stock accessory. There many to chose from but we recommend the ones designed for Clay Hunt VR: The Real Stock Pro from www.texturevr.com and the Duck Hunter from the www.megavr.co.uk.
